summary: Three distinct operating sponsors qualify out of 20 base records: Elm Grove 3 Capital ($16.56M, 2026-04-07), Elm Square 2 Capital ($15.48M, 2026-03-06) and Elm Point 1 Capital ($14.4M, 2026-02-05), all closed single-asset Retail acquisitions in Raleigh within the 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31 window and the $9M–$27M range, each with a current CFO verified on or after 2026-03-01. Exclusions were driven by executed amendments reclassifying four assets to Office (R4183, R6876, R3693, R3284), broker/manager firm kinds (R3292, R4981), an announced bid (R9425), a portfolio total (R9706), out-of-range size (R2109), out-of-window date (R3654), wrong market (R2866), unqualified or stale/former contacts (R2827, R6495, R4621), and post-cutoff publication (R9106). R3531 is eligible but deduplicated into R9588 (same entity ELM-SPO-34913). A prospect CSV with the same facts and citations was produced (artifacts/prospects-v1.csv); no contact was guessed and no null was filled.
limitations: R2814 hinges on the cutoff rule: the 2026-09-10 team page shows the CFO as former, so this lead may already be stale in practice even though the post-cutoff update is excluded.
R9106 (Elm Crossing 18, $17.64M, 2026-07-22) appears substantively qualifying but its only source was published 2026-09-03, after the cutoff; it could qualify on a later evidence date.
R3693's SPV-to-parent link maps to ELM-SPO-34913 (Elm Point 1), so even absent the Office amendment it would not have added a sponsor slot.
R4183 has no published email (contact_email null, email_basis not_published); it is excluded on asset type regardless, but no email could have been reported.

R3531 and R9588 are identical extracts for the same entity; the choice of R9588 as the shortlist record is based on its acquisition-release-and-team-page evidence kind, but no independent confirmation of which is the primary source is available.
Contact verification dates are taken at face value from the extracts; no independent re-verification of titles or emails was possible.
Missing fields (e.g., unpublished emails) are treated as unknown, not zero or blank-by-default.
